name: 空色のねこキャップ
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one finished transparent-background pixel-art game pet sprite, NOT an accessory icon or a contact sheet.
Input images: Image 1 is the CAT CHARACTER edit target. Image 2 is an accessory design reference gallery only; use ONLY the sky-blue cap with a tiny golden paw emblem shown in the first Lv.1 column.
Primary request: draw the exact cat from Image 1 naturally WEARING this Lv.1 sky-blue cap. Integrate the cap with the skull, ears and fur through correct perspective and natural occlusion. Keep both real cat ears visible, with the cap resting between/around them; do not add ears to the hat. Hat only: do not add any bow, cushion, collar change, or other reward.
Invariants: same gray and cream fur markings, amber eyes, pink nose, red bandana, cute proportions, full seated body, curled upright tail on viewer right, friendly neutral expression, camera angle, chunky square pixel scale, warm dark outline, limited colors and pixel shading as Image 1. Not a new cat design. Keep all paws, tail, ears and cap entirely visible.
Composition: exactly ONE integrated dressed cat centered on a square canvas, fixed seated baseline around 88% of canvas height, empty padding at least 10% on all sides; do not crop. No duplicate or separate item.
Background: genuine transparent RGBA alpha=0 outside the silhouette. Do NOT paint a checkerboard, white rectangle, colored background, floor, scene or drop shadow.
Avoid: smooth vector/3D look, blurry edges, captions, logos, watermark, UI, labels, extra pets, inventory icons.
